The '''Orange''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] grown by planting an [[Orange Sapling]], waiting 28 days for it to grow into an [[Orange Tree]], and harvesting the tree during the [[Summer]].

An Orange may be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|100}} or found in [[The Cave]] on the farm, if the fruit bat option is chosen.

==Bundles==
Orange is an option for the {{Bundle|Artisan||y}}.

==Recipes==
Orange is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Orange can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Relaxed Fit Shorts]]. [[File:Relaxed Fit Shorts.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Orange is not used in any [[quests]].
